metadata.title: भागवत की नसीहत का मोदी पर कितना असर | Will Modi go to Manipur | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) chief Mohan Bhagwat expressed deep concern over the prolonged unrest in Manipur, which has been ongoing since violence erupted in May last year. During a gathering of RSS leaders and trainees in Nagpur, Maharashtra, Bhagwat underscored the urgent need to restore peace in the northeastern state, emphasizing that it must be a priority. Addressing the issue for the second time, he stressed the importance of moving beyond election rhetoric to focus on the nation’s pressing problems. Experts interpret Bhagwat’s statement as a subtle critique of the Modi government’s handling of the situation and its priorities. Notably, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has yet to visit Manipur since the onset of the violence, a point that has drawn significant attention and criticism. Bhagwat's remarks highlight the need for immediate and effective action to address the turmoil in Manipur.
